shows: Bedrock's Chat Completions API takes the max_tokens and system messages of Kimi K3 and Kimi K3.1 Pro and applies their temperature and top_k, refuses top_p other than 0.95 and penalties other than 0, and answers seed, logit_bias, logprobs, web_search_options, repetition_penalty and a field that it does not know without applying them.
